TriggerMode.Name: Death Trigger
TriggerMode.Hint: How a death animation is fired. "Dead status on token" watches for the dead/defeated status (recommended for Crucible: the system applies its "dead" status both when heroes reach full wounds and when adversaries reach 0 health). "Actor HP reaches zero" watches actor health. "Manual" only fires from the Token HUD button or the macro API.

SweepDirection.Name: Sweep Direction
SweepDirection.Hint: Where the crumbling starts and how it travels across the token.

DissolveDuration.Name: Dissolve Duration
DissolveDuration.Hint: Seconds the crumbling sweep takes to cross the whole token.

ParticleDensity.Name: Particle Density
ParticleDensity.Hint: Multiplier for how much dust is released (0.2 to 3). The count also scales with token size.

WindDirection.Name: Wind Direction
WindDirection.Hint: Direction the wind blows toward, in degrees. 0 blows to the right, 90 downward.

WindStrength.Name: Wind Strength
WindStrength.Hint: Multiplier for how fast the wind carries the dust away.

Turbulence.Name: Turbulence
Turbulence.Hint: How much the dust wobbles and swirls while the wind carries it.

ParticleColor.Name: Particle Color
ParticleColor.Hint: Hex color of the dust, e.g. #0a0a0a (default: near-black).

AfterEffect.Name: After The Effect
AfterEffect.Hint: What happens to the token once the dust settles. "Hide" marks the token hidden. "Show" leaves the corpse visible. "Delete" removes the token document — destructive, GM only.

Debug.Name: Debug Logging
Debug.Hint: Print engine diagnostics to the browser console.

NOTIFICATIONS.NoCanvas: Dust to Dust: no active scene, the effect was skipped.
NOTIFICATIONS.InvalidTarget: Dust to Dust: could not resolve a token from the given target.
NOTIFICATIONS.AlreadyPlaying: Dust to Dust: that token is already dissolving.
